single_question: After matching immediate message displacement, which of message removal, proportional renormalization, fixed-donor redistribution, or the hard endpoint explains the pre-readout response?

inference.endpoint_discontinuity_contrast: H outcome effect minus the P outcome effect predicted at H realized message norm
inference.endpoint_continuity_fit: within each bootstrap resample and model/endpoint, ordinary least squares of P outcome effect on realized immediate-message norm using baseline plus P doses 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75; evaluate at the observed H immediate-message norm
inference.simultaneous_method: within-model max-studentized over all pairwise, classification-support and endpoint-discontinuity contrasts across the 3 primary endpoints
inference.difference_rule: simultaneous interval wholly outside the endpoint equivalence band
inference.equivalence_rule: simultaneous interval wholly inside the endpoint equivalence band
inference.band_rationale: pre-outcome minimum scientifically meaningful normalized-quality changes: 0.5 percentage point for query-local quality and 0.1 percentage point for per-object set utility

positive_control.success: for each model, at least one primary endpoint simultaneous interval lies wholly outside its frozen equivalence band

precision_rule.extend_to_256_if: any classification-required contrast/end-point interval is inconclusive and its half-width exceeds its endpoint equivalence-band width
precision_rule.do_not_extend_if: all classification-required intervals are difference or equivalent, or inconclusive intervals already have half-width <= equivalence-band width

classification.transport_equivalent: all M-P, M-D and P-D primary contrasts in both models equivalent
classification.renormalization_dependent: M-P and M-D differ while P-D is equivalent, with no conflicting endpoint/model class
classification.donor_dependent: P-D differs, with no conflicting endpoint/model class
classification.message_specific: M-baseline differs and P/D are baseline-equivalent or opposite-direction under simultaneous intervals, with no conflicting endpoint/model class
classification.endpoint_discontinuity: H departs from the frozen P continuity region under the endpoint-discontinuity simultaneous contrast
classification.mixed: primary endpoints or models yield more than one supported mechanism class
classification.inconclusive: no unique supported class at n=256, including assay failure
